title: General Introduction and Importance of Chemistry
notes: **Definition:** chemistry is the branch of science that studies the composition, structure, properties and changes of matter.
**Scope:** chemistry connects physics and biology. It explains how atoms bond into molecules, how reactions release or absorb energy, and how molecules carry biological information.

**Branches:** organic chemistry (carbon compounds), inorganic chemistry (rest of elements), physical chemistry (energy and rates), analytical chemistry (composition analysis), biochemistry (living systems).
**Everyday relevance:** cooking, cleaning, medicines, fuels, plastics, fertilizers, pigments, cosmetics â€” all depend on chemical principles.
**Industry:** chemical industry produces fertilizers, pharmaceuticals, polymers, detergents, pigments, and metals. Understanding chemistry is essential for process design and quality control.
